turns.say: I say good morning to Mr Okafor and ask what he would like today.

"Meet someone nice? A date?" My mind drifted to Dev. Are we actually together, or is it only physical? The draught from the door pulled me back. "Sure, Mr Okafor," I said, "if it helps you feel better."
I pick up the bag of rolls and ask Mags if she needs anything from the high street.
